decisions.H430_note: not testable as a graded claim: the intermediate buckets are empty

limits: Coverage is counted as training rows only, not as diversity of cells or pairs.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

the_first_run_of_this_script_had_a_bug_t.bug: the buckets began at 1, so rows with coverage 0 fell outside every bucket and were dropped silently
the_first_run_of_this_script_had_a_bug_t.consequence: the first run reported a single bucket holding 100 percent of rows and could not see the regime R182 had just studied
the_first_run_of_this_script_had_a_bug_t.fix: add an explicit zero bucket and record per-bucket row counts independently of the minimum-size filter
the_first_run_of_this_script_had_a_bug_t.lesson: a stratification whose lowest bin excludes zero will quietly delete the very cases that motivated it

coverage_in_this_resource_is_bimodal.reading: a pathway level in the both-unseen evaluation pool is either absent from training altogether or covered by more than two hundred training rows. There is no intermediate-coverage regime to test.
coverage_in_this_resource_is_bimodal.so: the applicability condition is a threshold on whether the level was observed at all, not a graded condition on how thickly it was observed
coverage_in_this_resource_is_bimodal.why_that_matters: I set out to look for a coverage threshold and found the data has no middle to place one in

the_two_regimes_differ.reading: where both levels are thickly covered the gain is two and a half times larger than where one is missing

but_the_absent_stratum_is_unstable_acros.reading: the point estimate is stable at about 0.058 across both runs, but whether its interval clears zero flips with the seed. So the correct statement is that the effect there is small and not reliably resolvable at this sample size, not that it is zero and not that it is established.
but_the_absent_stratum_is_unstable_acros.this_corrects_one_of_my_own_framings: R182's record called it 'not resolvable'; that is right on average but reads as more settled than it is
but_the_absent_stratum_is_unstable_acros.count: the inverse of my usual error: here I had it as 'not there', and a second seed says 'marginally there'
